report_name: Flurry of Ransomware Breaches Announced Against Diverse Global Sectors

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A highly prolific ransomware group that claimed responsibility for attacks against AppleOne Properties Inc., Assos Pharmaceuticals, and Cano Industrial, exfiltrating data and listing them on their data leak site as part of a double extortion scheme.

threat_actors.name: INC_RANSOM
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that targeted the U.S. healthcare sector, claiming a breach against Cabin Creek Health Systems and listing them on their data leak site.

threat_actors.name: NightSpire
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that targeted the European automotive sector, claiming an attack on Auto Royal Company in Italy.

threat_actors.name: KillSecurity
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group that announced a breach against the Canadian FinTech company Cash Cowboy.

threat_actors.name: TheGentlemen
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group that announced a breach against Ceska filharmonie, an arts organization in the Czech Republic.

threat_actors.name: KRYBIT
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group that announced a breach against CH. Karnchang Public Company Limited, a construction company in Thailand.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Used by ransomware groups as a core tactic of the double extortion model to encrypt victim files and disrupt operations.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Used by ransomware groups to exfiltrate victim data as part of the double extortion model, with attackers threatening to publish the data if the ransom is not paid.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The primary goal of the ransomware groups, threatening to publish exfiltrated data if the ransom is not paid as part of a double extortion scheme.

indicators.name: Ransomware Behavior: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via WMI
id: 5b43b6c0-9436-4247-8138-21f4c32e7339
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of WMI to delete volume shadow copies. This is a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a common ransomware behavior, the deletion of volume shadow copies to prevent system recovery, which was highlighted as a key detection point for ransomware attacks.

indicators.name: Ransomware Behavior: Mass File Encryption
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Mass File Encryption Activity
id: 9e8a0c4f-7f6d-4b9a-8d1c-3e5f7b9a2d0e
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of file modification events from a single process, which is indicative of ransomware encrypting files.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    EventType: 'File Modified'
  condition: selection | count(TargetFilename) by Image > 1000
indicators.description: Detects mass file modification, a core behavior of ransomware encrypting data for impact (T1486).

indicators.name: Ransomware Behavior: Disabling Security Tools
indicators.pattern:
title: Attempt to Disable Security Tools via Command Line
id: c4d5e6f7-a8b9-4012-8def-123456789012
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line activity aimed at stopping or disabling common antivirus and EDR services. This is a common precursor to ransomware deployment.
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' stop windefend'
      - ' stop mpssvc'
      - ' delete windefend'
      - ' delete mpssvc'
      - ' config windefend start= disabled'
      - ' config mpssvc start= disabled'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects attempts to disable security tools, a common ransomware behavior mentioned in the article's detection and response section.
